title: reconciliation.break_detected
description: One asset's ledger custody and its on-chain balance did not agree, and the difference is not explained by anything this system knows about. Every term of the comparison is carried, not just the difference: a consumer that only knows the amount cannot tell an uncredited deposit from a lost key, and those two want very different people woken up. Emitted when a break appears or its size changes, not on every pass -- a break that stays open stays visible in the report and the metric, and repeating it every few minutes only teaches people to filter it out.

report_id.description: The reconciliation pass that found it.

block_height.description: The block every balance in this comparison was read at.

ledger_total.description: custody_deposit_addresses + custody_hot. Can be negative: custody_hot goes negative between a withdrawal and the sweep that refills it.

chain_total.description: Every controlled deposit address plus the hot wallet, at block_height.

uncredited.description: Deposits the chain shows at or below block_height that the ledger has not credited yet. Makes the chain legitimately higher.

above_frontier.description: The net effect the ledger booked for transactions mined above block_height, which the balance read cannot see.

in_flight.description: What transactions mined at or below block_height have spent without the ledger having booked them yet.

diff.description: chain_total - ledger_total + above_frontier - uncredited + in_flight, and never zero in this event. Positive means the chain holds more than the ledger claims -- money that arrived by a path the scanner cannot see. Negative means it holds less, which is the one that cannot wait.
